## History

While staying at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) received a visit from a local boy named Sam. Shortly afterward, Sam awkwardly proposed to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). She politely rejected his proposal and later laughed about the incident with her landlady, [Janet](../character/janet.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P0](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0000), [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Philippa P8](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0008), [v3 ch.Philippa P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009), [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P20](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0020), +2 more_
